original_finding_content.subject: Medium — Creator reports $33,000 in 3 months on Payhip
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** A Medium author claims $33,000 in Payhip sales over 3 months using email marketing and articles.

**Verbatim snippet:** "I've made $33,000 on Payhip in 3 months without being a slave to social media. I've used email marketing mostly and articles."

**Source:** https://edinajackson.medium.com/ive-made-33-000-on-payhip-in-3-months-without-posting-on-social-media-apps-73e3a29ab932
**source_type:** article
**Date:** Accessed April 2026; page undated
**Notes:** Author (Edina Jackson) has multiple Medium posts about Payhip income and appears to be a content marketer/affiliate. Claims should be treated with skepticism. Original ID: C3.
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
